mission_10: Model distillation for interpretability transfers knowledge from a complex teacher model (like a deep neural network) into a simple interpretable student model (like a decision tree). Unlike standard distillation that uses only soft targets, interpretability-focused distillation combines soft teacher predictions (capturing class relationships through temperature-scaled softmax) with hard ground truth labels. The temperature parameter controls the smoothness of the teacher's probability distribution — higher temperatures reveal more information about relative class confidences. In this mission, you implement the full distillation pipeline: temperature-scaled softmax for soft targets, combined loss weighting between soft and hard targets, decision tree training on augmented targets, fidelity evaluation, rule extraction with confidence scores, and progressive distillation that searches for the optimal depth-accuracy trade-off.
